proposals.value: Capability has receded from headline to background condition. Coverage treats model performance as table stakes: parity is the expectation, and benchmarks no longer decide outcomes. The open question is which capabilities—reasoning, reliability, autonomy—translate into durable advantage once frontier gains become common. A speculative thread on self-improving models keeps the perspective alive, but it no longer frames the race.

proposals.value: The platform perspective has become the race's central thesis. Coverage concentrates on distribution, defaults and ecosystems: agent interfaces, API moats and app-store analogies dominate. The argument is that whoever owns the default entry point to AI—where users and developers actually land—captures value that raw capability alone cannot secure, making platform governance itself a competitive battleground.

proposals.value: Infrastructure has shifted from background context to binding constraint. Coverage now spans energy, silicon, siting and edge devices: grid capacity, semiconductor supply and data-center buildouts determine what deployment is feasible, and at what pace. The argument is that compute access, not model access, separates serious competitors from aspirants—and that physical constraints favor incumbents with capital, land and power contracts.

proposals.value: The economics perspective converges on one unresolved question: as inference costs collapse, where does durable value accrue? Coverage weighs a productivity paradox, competing theories of surplus capture, and cost-driven model selection. The through-line is that cheap intelligence may compress margins everywhere except at the choke points—distribution, compute and trust—where scarcity persists. Source volume remains thin, so conclusions warrant caution.

proposals.value: The human-impact perspective has moved from near-invisibility to a recurring editorial lens. Coverage spans the future of work, education, creative attribution, safety diplomacy and the global AI divide, asking who benefits from scaled deployment and who is displaced. Still newest by volume, it increasingly supplies the evaluative standard against which the rest of the race is judged.
